sn46.24:1.1: Ayoniso bhikkhave manasikaroto anuppanno ceva kāmacchando uppajjati || uppanno ca kāmacchando bhiyyobhāvāya vepullāya saṃvattati || 3.
sn46.24:1.2: Anuppanno ceva byāpādo uppajjati || uppanno ca byāpādo bhiyyobhāvāya vepullāya saṃvattati || 4.
sn46.24:1.3: Anuppannaṃ ceva thīnamiddham uppajjati || uppannañca thīnamiddham bhiyyobhāvāya vepullāya saṃvattati || || 5.
sn46.24:1.4: Anuppannaṃ ceva uddhaccakukkaccam uppajjati || uppannaṃ ca uddhaccakukkuccam bhiyyobhāvāya vepullāya saṃvattati || || 6.
sn46.24:1.5: Anuppannā ceva vicikicchā uppajjati || uppannā ca vivikicchā bhiyyobhāvāya vepullāya saṃvattati || || 7.
sn46.24:1.6: Anuppanno ceva satisambojjhaṅgo nuppajjati uppano ca satisambojjhaṅgo nirujjhati || la-pe || Anuppanno ceva upekhāsambojjhaṅgo nuppajjati || uppanno ca upekhāsambojjhaṅgo nirujjhati || || 8.
sn46.24:2.1: Yoniso ca kho bhikkhave manasikaroto anuppanno ceva kāmacchando nuppajjati || uppanno ca kāmacchando pahīyati || || 9.
sn46.24:2.2: Anuppanno ceva byāpādo nuppajjati || uppanno ca byāpādo pahīyati || || 10.
sn46.24:2.3: Anuppannañ ceva thīnamiddhaṃ nuppajjati || uppannaṃ ca ṭhīnamiddham pahīyati || || 11.
sn46.24:2.4: Anuppannañ ceva uddhaccakukkuccaṃ nuppajjati || uppannañca uddhaccakukkuccam pahīyati || || 12.
sn46.24:2.5: Anuppannā ceva vicikicchā nuppajjati || uppannā ca vicikicchā pahīyati || || 13.
sn46.24:3.1: Anuppanno ceva satisambojjhaṅgo uppajjati || uppanno ca satisambojjhaṅgo bhāvanā pāripūriṃ gacchati || la-pe || || anuppanno ceva upekhāsambojjhaṅgo uppajjati || uppanno ca upekhāsambojjhaṅgo bhāvanā pāripūriṃ gacchatī
